annotations.title: Record a file in a proof ledger

description: Record a file's hash in a signed, append-only ledger, a backtest result or a returns file, so anyone can later check this exact file existed by then. Nothing else about the file is claimed.

file.description: The file to record: a backtest's result, a returns file, a league entry. Only its hash goes in the ledger.

ledger_file.description: The ledger file; started if new.
